title: Bugfix: preserve rows when region mapping is null/unknown in unit economics aggregation
author: Mei Lin
description:
Context: After merging the region normalization work, we noticed intermittent drops in hourly unit economics aggregates where a small (but non-trivial) slice of metering rows had region unset or had a value that didn’t map (e.g. legacy colo labels, nulls from older gateway paths, or "unknown" emitted during partial outages). The aggregation job used an INNER JOIN to the canonical region mapping table, which caused those rows to be dropped entirely. This under-counted output_tokens and made $/1M output tokens look artificially worse/better depending on which spend inputs were present for that hour.

What this PR does: Update the unit economics aggregation query and the region mapping helper to be null-safe and non-dropping: (1) switch the join to LEFT JOIN, (2) COALESCE to a canonical region value of "unknown" when mapping fails, and (3) emit an explicit counter for unmapped rows so we can alert on drift instead of silently losing data. Also adds a small regression test covering null + unmapped region values.

Why this is safe: The change only affects how we assign the region dimension for rows that previously disappeared; mapped rows are unchanged. Downstream views already treat region as a dimension with a bounded value set, and adding "unknown" is within our cardinality guardrails.

Test plan: Run unit tests for the query builder + add a warehouse integration test fixture that includes null and unmapped region inputs; validate that output_tokens totals match pre-join totals and that the "unknown" bucket contains the expected rows.

Rollout: Deploy with the next scheduled analytics job release; monitor (a) unit_econ.region_mapping.unmapped_rows, (b) hourly completeness checks, and (c) reconciliation deltas vs billing totals. If the unmapped counter spikes, we’ll investigate upstream emitters rather than letting the aggregator hide the issue.
commits: unit-econ: make region mapping join null-safe and non-dropping
metrics: add unmapped region counter + structured log fields
tests: add regression coverage for null/unmapped region values
docs: update runbook note on unknown region bucket
notable_diff_snippet:
Before:
  ...
  FROM metering_events e
  JOIN dim_region_map m
    ON e.raw_region = m.raw_region

After:
  ...
  FROM metering_events e
  LEFT JOIN dim_region_map m
    ON e.raw_region = m.raw_region
  -- Preserve rows even if mapping is missing; bucket them explicitly.
  SELECT COALESCE(m.canonical_region, 'unknown') AS region,
         ...
  
  -- Emit unmapped rows metric for visibility.
  unmapped = (m.canonical_region IS NULL)
  metrics.increment('unit_econ.region_mapping.unmapped_rows', 1, { raw_region: COALESCE(e.raw_region, 'null') })
review_conversation:
Logan Wright (review): Good catch. Can you confirm this doesn’t change mapped rows and only affects the missing mapping cases? Also please add an explicit metric so we can alert when this starts happening.

Mei Lin (author): Confirmed. The SELECT now uses COALESCE(m.canonical_region, 'unknown') but for mapped rows m.canonical_region is unchanged. Added unit_econ.region_mapping.unmapped_rows counter with raw_region tag bounded to 'null' or the raw string (still low cardinality in practice, but let me know if we want to hash).

Caleb Johnson (review): +1 on surfacing visibility. We should avoid high-cardinality raw_region tags. Can we bucket raw_region into {null, empty, unknown, other}?

Mei Lin (author): Updated. Tag value is now one of ['null', 'empty', 'unknown', 'unmapped_other']. We still log the exact raw_region to structured logs for debugging, but not as a metric label.

Cole Summers (review): Does this impact reconciliation vs billing totals? We’ll see token totals increase for hours that previously dropped rows.

Mei Lin (author): Yes, it will increase output_tokens in those hours (more accurate). This should reduce reconciliation deltas. I added a note in the PR description + the runbook about the 'unknown' region bucket.

Sean Gallagher (review): Please ensure we don’t silently treat unknown as a real region in dashboards. Any UI impact?

Mei Lin (author): No UI changes here, but the dashboard already treats dimensions as enumerations. 'unknown' will show up in the breakdown tables; we can decide later if we want to hide it by default. For now, it’s better than dropping data.

Approvals: Logan Wright approved. Caleb Johnson approved after metric label change. Sean Gallagher approved.
release_notes: Fixes undercounting in unit economics aggregates by retaining rows with null/unmapped region and bucketing them into region='unknown'. Adds an unmapped-row metric for alerting and a regression test.
